block.ashen_requiem_world.broken_workben: Still needs %s scraped log(s) and %s scrap
jei.ashen_requiem_world.scraping.note: Use the knife on the block (1 durability)
jei.ashen_requiem_world.repairing.note: Use each item on the block, one at a time
jei.ashen_requiem_world.info.rubble: Heaps of rubble lie across the Dead Lands. Break them for scrap, and now and then a stick.
jei.ashen_requiem_world.info.scrap: Comes from breaking rubble, which lies across the Dead Lands. The first thing you can work with.
jei.ashen_requiem_world.info.scrap_knife: Use it on a dead log or dead wood to scrape the radiated bark off. Each scrape costs 1 durability.
jei.ashen_requiem_world.info.dead_log: The Dead Lands' trees are long dead, their bark radiated. Scrape it off with a scrap knife before the wood is any use.
jei.ashen_requiem_world.info.broken_work: The Cradle's workbench, broken. Use %s scraped logs and %s scrap on it to repair it.
jei.ashen_requiem_world.info.workbench: Works like a crafting table. Some recipes need its 3×3 grid and can't be made in the inventory.
